reviews.review: There's this racist chick, who makes it a point to tell her white male companion (i.e. - me) that she's saved his live three times at the very start, goes on about "old white dudes" in the tutorial.  Seriously?  I did some homework, and learned that this nonsense was restricted to just the tutorial section, but come on...we white and Asian dudes are the only reason this industry even exists.  We built gaming through our love and sacrifice.  Everyone will always be welcome in this space, but never forget who created it.  Your snarky little racist comments don't belong here.

Remnant 2 is like if Dark Souls, Destiny, and a fever dream had a baby – and then that baby picked up a gun and said, “Let’s go multiverse-hopping.”

This game is wildly fun. The combat is punchy, responsive, and just chaotic enough to make every encounter feel intense without being unfair. Boss fights? Epic. Enemies? Weird and awesome. Guns? So satisfying. And the build variety? Chef’s kiss – you can really go nuts customizing your playstyle.

What I love most is the unpredictability. No two runs feel the same. The worlds are beautiful, creepy, and creatively designed – you never know what’s waiting around the next corner. Sometimes it’s loot, sometimes it’s lore, and sometimes it’s... a cosmic horror that deletes your health bar in 3 seconds. Fun times!

It’s also a blast to play in co-op. Nothing beats shouting “REVIVE ME” while your friend desperately dodges laser beams and eldritch tentacles.

Great pacing, tons of replay value, solid challenge, and a weirdly compelling atmosphere.

Highly recommended if you like action, mystery, and yelling “WHAT WAS THAT?!” at your screen at least once per hour.

Very good game marred by awful bugs and stability issues (i mean seriously how do you not patch the game having memory leaks?)

if you're a veteran to jank games you'll probably enjoy this. and if you loved remnant 1 you'll probably love this game too. its just more of the same but better, the worlds however are certainly less interesting
